manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
